historical_record.description: J. S. Hannah & Co. contracted for masonry, carpentry, painting, plumbing and electrical work on three-storey and basement frame flats.

Sold for $30,000, deed recorded February 20, 1970. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, filing it as a comparable sale, described three-story Victorian wood-frame flats (one four-room and two five-room flats), rustic siding, full basement, built about 1895.

In the Redevelopment Agency's 1962 acquisition appraisal for Western Addition A-2, the appraiser Maury Holmes put the market value of the property at $25,000 and rated it in good condition. He described a three-story frame building of three six-room flats with a partial storage basement.
